instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Access RubyGems Rails gem page without signing in/downloading
criteria.description: Attempt to navigate to RubyGems Rails gem page (e.g., https://rubygems.org/gems/rails) and/or the latest-version dependencies view without signing in and without downloading/installing the gem. Full credit if the agent uses RubyGems pages successfully OR if RubyGems is blocked/unavailable (CAPTCHA, downtime, access denied) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what it tried. Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or uses an unrelated source despite RubyGems being accessible.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the RubyGems rails gem page on the Dependencies tab for version 8.1.3.1 (latest). “Sign in”/“Sign up” buttons are visible but not used; no download/install actions are shown.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence confirms the agent accessed RubyGems for rails without signing in or downloading/installing anything. Baseline stands.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the RubyGems site (logo “RubyGems” top-left) with navigation (“blog”, “stats”, “docs”, “about”), a search bar (“Search Gems…”), and buttons “Sign in” and “Sign up” visible but not engaged. Breadcrumb indicates “rails > 8.1.3.1 (latest) > Dependencies”. The page is the “Dependencies” tab for the rails gem.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Full credit: the screenshot confirms access to the Rails gem’s latest version dependencies page on RubyGems without signing in, and there is no evidence of downloading/installing the gem.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy: the page is clearly RubyGems and shows the dependencies view for rails 8.1.3.1 (latest); no sign-in action is shown.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 (latest/only) shows URL https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies with visible unauthenticated nav (e.g., “Sign in” / “Sign up”) and a “13 Runtime Dependencies” table. No DOM indications of downloading/installing. Action history shows navigation/click to Dependencies link.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports the agent accessed the RubyGems Rails dependencies page without signing in and without any download/install actions. Baseline remains correct.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the agent is on RubyGems without signing in: URL is https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies with page title "rails | RubyGems.org | your community gem host". The page also contains a visible link "Sign in" ([1067]) and "Sign up" ([1068]), indicating the session is not authenticated and no sign-in flow is active in this state. The content includes the Rails version context "rails" and version "8.1.3.1" with publish date "July 29, 2026" under "Details". The dependency table (Table 1) lists "13 Runtime Dependencies" and includes entries like "actioncable 8.1.3.1" with required version "= 8.1.3.1", confirming successful access to the RubyGems dependencies view without downloading/installing anything. No DOM evidence indicates any download/install actions were taken.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The DOM state explicitly demonstrates successful access to the RubyGems Rails gem’s latest-version dependencies page without signing in or installing/downloading. Evidence: the URL is a RubyGems gem dependency page (DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1, URL: https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies) and includes navigation and content for "rails" version "8.1.3.1" plus "13 Runtime Dependencies". The presence of a "Sign in" link ([1067]) and absence of any authenticated-user indicators supports that the agent is not signed in. There is no DOM indication of any gem download/install action being performed; the state is purely a web page view listing dependencies.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None for Criterion 0. The DOM supports that RubyGems pages were accessed (Rails dependencies view) without signing in and without evidence of downloading/installing.

criteria.criterion: Record latest displayed Rails version metadata
criteria.description: Report the latest displayed Rails version’s metadata as shown on RubyGems: (1) version number, (2) release date, (3) required Ruby version, and (4) license. Full credit if all four fields match RubyGems for the latest displayed version. If RubyGems pages are inaccessible, full credit if the agent explicitly states the metadata could not be verified due to the blocker; partial credit if it uses a clearly-identified fallback that does not require install/download (e.g., RubyGems public API) and reports fields from there. No credit if the agent hallucinates values or reports a non-latest version when the latest is visible.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows “rails 8.1.3.1” and the release date “July 29, 2026” on the Dependencies page. The screenshot does not show required Ruby version or license anywhere in the visible area.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s version and release date are visually supported. However, the claimed required Ruby version (>= 3.2.0) and license (MIT) are not supported by the provided screenshot or action history (no prior gem info page evidence shown). Award partial credit for the two confirmed metadata fields only.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: Visible on the left: gem name “rails” with version “8.1.3.1” and date “July 29, 2026”. The screenshot does NOT show any field for “Required Ruby version” nor “License” anywhere in the visible area. It is on the “Dependencies” tab (not “Gem info”).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Partial: version number (8.1.3.1) and release date (July 29, 2026) are confirmed by the screenshot. However, the required Ruby version and license are not visible on this dependencies page screenshot, so the agent’s predicted output values for those fields cannot be verified from the provided image and appear unsupported by screenshot evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent claims “Required Ruby version: >= 3.2.0” and “License: MIT (from prior step’s Gem info page)”. The screenshot provided does not show required Ruby version or license, so these claims are not supported by this screenshot.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 shows version labeled “8.1.3.1 (latest)” and under Details shows release date “July 29, 2026.” The same DOM state does NOT display “Required Ruby version” or “License” anywhere in captured text. No other DOM states provided.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent’s reported version and release date are supported by DOM, but required Ruby version (>= 3.2.0) and license (MIT) are not evidenced in the provided DOM/action history (agent references a “prior step” that is not in evidence). Award partial credit for the two supported metadata fields only.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the Dependencies page for rails version 8.1.3.1 at URL https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies. In VISIBLE CONTENT under “Details” it lists “rails”, “8.1.3.1”, and the release date text “July 29, 2026”. In READ-ONLY CONTROL EVIDENCE it shows “8.1.3.1 (latest)”, indicating this version is the latest displayed. However, this state does not display the “Required Ruby version” field nor the “License” field anywhere in the captured DOM text for this page/state.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
Criterion requires reporting four metadata fields for the latest version: version number, release date, required Ruby version, and license. The DOM supports that the latest displayed version is 8.1.3.1 via READ-ONLY CONTROL EVIDENCE: “8.1.3.1 (latest)” and supports the release date via VISIBLE CONTENT: “July 29, 2026”. The DOM does not contain the required Ruby version or license in this state (dependencies page), so those two fields cannot be verified from the provided DOM-model evidence.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent-reported metadata included “Required Ruby version: >= 3.2.0” and “License: MIT”, but DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 provides no text for required Ruby version or license; thus these two claims are unsupported by the DOM evidence. Version 8.1.3.1 and release date July 29, 2026 are supported.

criteria.criterion: Record runtime dependency #1 in displayed order (name + requirement)

Full credit if correct and in position; if the dependency list is not accessible due to RubyGems issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot be retrieved. Partial credit if the name is correct but the requirement/order is missing or incorrect.

screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Matches the agent’s #1 runtime dependency exactly (name, order, requirement).

evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None for dependency #1; it matches the displayed first row and requirement.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 Table “13 Runtime Dependencies” lists first row as “actioncable 8.1.3.1” with required version “= 8.1.3.1.”

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the RubyGems dependencies page for rails version 8.1.3.1 at URL https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies. In TABLES -> Table 1 (Gem | Required version), the first runtime dependency row is explicitly listed as: “actioncable 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1”. This is also reflected in VISIBLE CONTENT/controls via link text “actioncable 8.1.3.1” and the combined read-only text line “actioncable 8.1.3.1 = 8.1.3.1 …”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The criterion asks for the 1st runtime dependency (name + requirement) in displayed order for the latest Rails version. DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 contains the runtime dependencies table for rails 8.1.3.1, where the first row under “Gem | Required version” is “actioncable 8.1.3.1” with requirement “= 8.1.3.1”. This directly supports recording runtime dependency #1 as actioncable with version requirement = 8.1.3.1, in first position.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy for runtime dependency #1: the agent’s recorded #1 (“actioncable (= 8.1.3.1)”) matches DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 Table 1 first row “actioncable 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1”.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording requested metadata and first five runtime dependencies
criteria.description: Stop once the latest displayed version’s metadata and the first five runtime dependencies have been recorded. Full credit if the response does not enumerate additional dependencies beyond five and does not continue with unrelated steps. Partial credit if minor extra context is included but the required items are clearly present and no extra dependencies are listed. No credit if the agent lists more than five runtime dependencies or omits required items despite availability.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows more than five runtime dependencies exist, but the agent’s output lists only the first five and stops.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent complied with the stopping condition by not enumerating beyond the first five runtime dependencies.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows more than five dependencies listed (e.g., actionview, activejob, activemodel, activerecord are visible below), but the agent’s predicted output lists only the first five (actioncable through actiontext) and then stops.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Full credit: the agent output stops after recording metadata and the first five runtime dependencies; it does not enumerate additional dependencies beyond five.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancy regarding stopping condition: while the page visibly contains additional dependencies, the agent did not list them in the final output.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Agent output enumerates exactly five runtime dependencies and stops. DOM-model state 1 confirms there are more (13 runtime dependencies), but the first five listed by the agent match the first five rows shown.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Stopping condition is satisfied: the agent did not list more than five runtime dependencies and did not continue beyond the requested scope (even though metadata was incomplete, this criterion is about stopping after the recorded items).

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the agent is on the dependencies page for a specific version: URL `https://rubygems.org/gems/rails/versions/8.1.3.1/dependencies`. The page’s visible content includes the version and date: in VISIBLE CONTENT under Details it lists `8.1.3.1` and `July 29, 2026`, and READ-ONLY CONTROL EVIDENCE includes `8.1.3.1 (latest)`. The runtime dependencies list is explicitly shown in TABLE 1 (rows=13) and the first five rows after the header are: `actioncable 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1`, `actionmailbox 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1`, `actionmailer 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1`, `actionpack 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1`, `actiontext 8.1.3.1 | = 8.1.3.1`. The navigation also labels `13 Runtime Dependencies` (VISIBLE CONTENT, Gem navigation).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The rubric criterion is about stopping after recording the latest version’s metadata and the first five runtime dependencies, without enumerating more than five. The agent’s predicted output lists exactly five runtime dependencies (actioncable, actionmailbox, actionmailer, actionpack, actiontext) and no additional dependencies, matching the first five entries in DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 TABLE 1 in the same order and with the same version requirements (`= 8.1.3.1`). The agent then states it is stopping after recording these items, satisfying the stopping condition. No evidence in the provided response indicates the agent continued beyond the first five dependencies.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: While the DOM supports the version `8.1.3.1` as latest and the release date `July 29, 2026`, the criterion assessed here (stopping after five runtime dependencies) is satisfied. Note: required Ruby version and license claimed by the agent are not present in DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1, but that is outside this single criterion’s scope.
